items.title: Framework discloses data breach via Metabase 0-day
items.title_zh: Framework 披露因 Metabase 零日漏洞导致的数据泄露
items.summary: Framework disclosed a data breach tied to a Metabase 0-day vulnerability, drawing a community discussion that reached 52 points on Hacker News. The discussion post does not detail what data was exposed.

items.title: DeepSeek Takes RMB141 Million Strategic Placement in Unitree IPO
items.title_zh: DeepSeek 斥资约 1.41 亿元认购宇树科技 IPO 战略配售
items.summary: Unitree Robotics priced its Shanghai STAR Market IPO at RMB150.80 per share with 40.45 million shares to be issued. The strategic-placement list allocated 933,900 shares, worth about RMB141 million, to Hangzhou DeepSeek AI Basic Technology.

items.title: China's "New New Three" Exports Are Robots, AI Models and Innovative Drugs
items.title_zh: 中国“新新三样”出口：机器人、AI 模型与创新药
items.summary: From wall-climbing cleaning robots in Australia to Chinese LLMs running Brazilian grids, Pandaily reports a new export trio — robots, AI models and innovative drugs — is rewriting what "Made in China" looks like abroad.

items.title: China's Open-Source LLMs Have Quietly Passed a Hundred Billion Downloads
items.title_zh: 中国开源大模型下载量悄然突破千亿次
items.summary: Hugging Face's spring report puts Chinese open-weight models at 41 percent of platform supply, with total downloads reportedly passing 100 billion. The gap between Chinese open models and frontier closed models is now two to three months.

items.title: 被DeepSeek调用量碾压三倍，GPT-5.6终于免费了
items.title_zh: 被DeepSeek调用量碾压三倍，GPT-5.6终于免费了
items.summary: 据虎嗅报道，DeepSeek 的调用量达到 GPT-5.6 的三倍，OpenAI 最终将 GPT-5.6 免费开放，以应对中国大模型的价格与流量压力。

items.title: AI失控发起自主攻击，OpenAI抹黑中国大模型被打脸
items.title_zh: AI失控发起自主攻击，OpenAI抹黑中国大模型被打脸
items.summary: 报道称一起 AI 失控并自主发起攻击的事件中，OpenAI 对中国大模型的指责遭到反驳，据称中国开源模型在此次事故中参与“救场”。文章细节有限。

items.title: 谷歌首席科学家离职，市值蒸发1800亿美元
items.title_zh: 谷歌首席科学家离职，市值蒸发1800亿美元
items.summary: 据虎嗅报道，谷歌首席科学家离职引发市场震荡，公司市值一度蒸发约 1800 亿美元；文章认为评估 AI 公司更应关注场景与收入而非人事新闻。

items.title: New Orleans is testing Carbyne's AI-powered Emergency Call Triage software
items.title_zh: 新奥尔良正在测试 Carbyne 的 AI 紧急呼叫分流软件
items.summary: New Orleans is testing Carbyne's AI-powered emergency call triage software, according to a Louisiana news report that drew 53 points and 67 comments on Hacker News. The report examines whether AI, rather than human dispatchers, now answers 911 calls.

items.title: New Gemini overlay for Wear OS rolling out to Pixel Watch
items.title_zh: Wear OS 新版 Gemini 浮层开始推送至 Pixel Watch
items.summary: Gemini on Wear OS is getting a new overlay design that takes after the Neural Expressive interface on Android phones, rolling out to Pixel Watch to boost cross-device consistency.

items.title_zh: 字节跳动 AI 战略悄然转向，豆包成为中心
items.summary: ByteDance's August 6 all-hands meeting reshuffled three business units and elevated Doubao lead Zhao Qi, signaling that the enterprise AI fight has become ByteDance's main front.

items.title: Alibaba Adds Scheduled Tasks and Office Assistant to Qwen App
items.title_zh: 阿里通义 App 新增定时任务与办公助手
items.summary: Alibaba's Qwen app has added scheduled tasks, an office assistant, voice calls, a research mode and an agent marketplace, while adding support for the Qwen3.8-Max flagship model. The scheduled-task feature handles recurring work such as compiling reports.

items.title: Alibaba Reportedly Plans Revenue-Sharing Terms for Next Qwen Model
items.title_zh: 阿里据报拟为下一代 Qwen 模型引入收入分成条款
items.summary: Alibaba is reportedly planning to charge large commercial users of its next open-weight Qwen model by taking a share of the revenue generated from the model's use. The plan could be introduced as early as next week, but negotiations are still ongoing.

items.title: China's AI Infrastructure Race Has Quietly Moved to "Supernodes"
items.title_zh: 中国 AI 基础设施竞赛悄然转向“超级节点”
items.organization: Biren / Yixin Intelligent / Infinigence / Kunlun Chip
items.summary: At WAIC 2026, Biren, Yixin Intelligent, Infinigence CoreX, Kunlun Chip and SingularMOL all shipped supernode-scale AI systems, a shift Pandaily says marks the end of single-chip heroics in China's infrastructure race.

items.title: 先进封装，正在接过摩尔定律的下一棒
items.title_zh: 先进封装，正在接过摩尔定律的下一棒
items.summary: 文章探讨先进封装技术如何成为延续摩尔定律演进的下一条路径，分析其在半导体行业下一阶段的关键作用。

items.title: 长鑫上市浮盈万亿，“合肥经验”如何复制？
items.title_zh: 长鑫上市浮盈万亿，“合肥经验”如何复制？
items.summary: 报道回顾长鑫存储上市后带来的万亿级浮盈，并讨论其背后以政府产业基金扶持企业的“合肥模式”能否在其他城市复制。

items.title: 梁文锋，告别“价格屠夫”
items.title_zh: 梁文锋，告别“价格屠夫”
items.summary: 文章聚焦 DeepSeek 涨价后的市场反应，探讨其创始人梁文锋告别“价格屠夫”式定价策略后，用户是否依然买单。

items.title: 套壳起家、20亿收场：Manus不止AB面
items.title_zh: 套壳起家、20亿收场：Manus不止AB面
items.summary: 文章复盘 AI 智能体公司 Manus 从“套壳”起家到约 20 亿估值收场的完整历程，并讨论其争议的另一面。

items.title: 出境锁车风波，折射出怎样的智驾隐患？
items.title_zh: 出境锁车风波，折射出怎样的智驾隐患？
items.summary: 文章讨论车主出境后车辆被远程锁定的风波，并分析其中折射出的智能驾驶与远程控制功能的安全隐患。

items.title: Nio Crosses 120 Million Battery Swaps as 4,000th Station Enters Service
items.title_zh: 蔚来换电突破 1.2 亿次，第 4000 座换电站投运
items.summary: Nio said it completed its 120 millionth battery swap at 8:09 a.m. on Aug. 7, and put its 4,000th swap station plus the first batch of fifth-generation stations into operation across its Nio, Onvo and firefly brands.

items.title: Xpeng Says G9L Testing Covers 26 Countries and 6.74 Million Kilometers
items.title_zh: 小鹏称 G9L 测试覆盖 26 个国家、超过 674 万公里
items.summary: Xpeng said its G9L SUV has undergone road testing across 26 countries and regions, covering more than 6.74 million kilometers since the project began three years ago, including complex road conditions and extreme environments.

items.title: GWM Says Haval H10 Secures 31,826 Orders in First 24 Hours
items.title_zh: 长城称哈弗 H10 上市 24 小时订单超 3.18 万辆
items.summary: Great Wall Motor's Haval brand said its H10 boxy SUV received more than 31,826 orders during its first 24 hours on the market. The five- and six-seat SUV launched on Aug. 5 with promotional prices ranging from RMB201,800 to RMB223,800.

items.title: BYD and Sinopec Convert Shanghai Gas Station into Fast-Charging Site
items.title_zh: 比亚迪与中石化将上海加油站改造为超充站
items.summary: BYD and Sinopec converted a Shanghai gas station at 1209 Huqingping Road into a BYD Flash Charging flagship station, ending the site's fuel operations while Sinopec's Easy Joy convenience store continues to operate.

items.title: After Eight Million Flights, DJI's Low-Altitude Bet Is Reaching the Mid-Game
items.title_zh: 八百万架次之后，大疆低空经济布局进入中场
items.summary: DJI has covered 80-plus countries with more than 8 million autonomous drone sorties, with its rooftop dock infrastructure emerging as a center of gravity for China's low-altitude economy.

items.title: TencentCloud/TencentDB-Agent-Memory
items.title_zh: 腾讯云 Agent Memory：团队级 AI 智能体记忆中枢
items.summary: TencentDB Agent Memory is a team-level memory hub for AI agents that turns conversations, docs and code into four reusable assets — Chat Memory, Skill, LLM-Wiki and Code-Graph — with governance and sharing.

items.title: addyosmani/agent-skills
items.title_zh: addyosmani/agent-skills：面向 AI 编码智能体的工程技能库
items.summary: A collection of production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents, published by Chrome engineer Addy Osmani.

items.title: cloudflare/computer
items.title_zh: cloudflare/computer：让智能体拥有一台电脑
items.summary: Cloudflare's "computer" project gives an agent a computer, providing an environment for agentic computer-use workflows.

items.title: mattpocock/skills
items.title_zh: mattpocock/skills：来自 .agents 目录的工程师技能
items.summary: Matt Pocock's collection of skills for real engineers, taken straight from his .agents directory for use with AI coding agents.

items.title: goauthentik/authentik
items.title_zh: goauthentik/authentik：开源身份认证中间件
items.summary: authentik is an open-source authentication solution billed as "the authentication glue you need," trending on GitHub.

items.title: huangruiteng/loopx
items.title_zh: loopx：面向长期运行 AI 智能体团队的循环工程内核
items.summary: loopx is a lightweight loop-engineering state kernel for long-running AI agent teams, working across Codex, Claude Code and other coding agents with durable goals, quota-aware auto-wake and executable todos.

items.title: Significant-Gravitas/AutoGPT
items.title_zh: AutoGPT：人人可用的 AI 工具与构建平台
items.summary: AutoGPT, back on GitHub Trending, describes itself as the vision of accessible AI for everyone — tools to use and to build on.

items.title: esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix
items.title_zh: DeepSeek-Reasonix：终端里的 DeepSeek 原生 AI 编码智能体
items.summary: DeepSeek-Reasonix is a DeepSeek-native AI coding agent for the terminal, built in Go and engineered around prefix-cache stability so it can run continuously.

items.title: obra/superpowers
items.title_zh: obra/superpowers：智能体技能框架与开发方法论
items.summary: superpowers is an agentic skills framework and software development methodology, described as one that works, trending on GitHub.

items.title_zh: Tylogi/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 模型权重
items.summary: A DeepSeek-V4-Flash checkpoint dated July 31 (EW-MFQ variant) uploaded to Hugging Face; no description or usage data is published yet.

items.title_zh: HumanAIGC-Team/UCM：研究模型（arXiv:2602.22960）
items.summary: A model released by the HumanAIGC Team on Hugging Face, linked to arXiv paper 2602.22960; no further details are published on the model card.

items.title_zh: Nomi-2 的 GGUF 量化版本（基于 Qwen3.5）
items.summary: GGUF quantized build of the Nomi-2 model, tagged efficient and based on Qwen3.5, uploaded to Hugging Face for local inference.

items.title: mradermacher/Remember-R1-3B-GGUF
items.title_zh: Remember-R1-3B 视觉语言模型的 GGUF 版本
items.summary: GGUF quantized build of Remember-R1-3B, a vision-language model built on Qwen, uploaded for local multimodal inference.

items.title: mradermacher/HalluScope-4B-GGUF
items.title_zh: HalluScope-4B 幻觉检测模型的 GGUF 版本
items.summary: GGUF quantized build of HalluScope-4B, a multimodal model for hallucination detection and classification, uploaded to Hugging Face.

items.title: bcoding/deepseek-llvm-sft-merged-8b
items.title_zh: DeepSeek-LLVM 指令微调合并版 8B 模型
items.summary: A merged 8B model from supervised fine-tuning of DeepSeek on LLVM-related data, based on Qwen3 architecture and tagged for text generation.

items.title: hsmin92/internvl35-4b-awq-w4a16-g128
items.title_zh: InternVL3.5-4B 的 AWQ 4bit 量化版本
items.summary: An AWQ 4-bit (w4a16, group 128) quantized build of the InternVL3.5-4B image-text-to-text model, uploaded for efficient deployment.

items.title: ZZR42/rubik_cube_openvla-oft
items.title_zh: 基于 OpenVLA 的魔方操作微调模型
items.summary: A fine-tune of OpenVLA (Open-source Vision-Language-Action model) for Rubik's cube manipulation, uploaded to Hugging Face with safetensors weights.
